description: Changes the posture of a foldable. On emulators it moves the simulated hinge (`emu posture`); on physical devices or for REAR_DISPLAY it uses `cmd device_state state`. Accepts the name (closed, half_opened, opened, rear_display), the numeric id or "reset" to go back to the sensor posture. Returns the new state.

serial.description: adb serial (e.g. emulator-5556). Optional when only one device is connected.

name: set_posture
title: Set posture
